evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Company-level velocity language ('ship more', 'challenged a lot') is present but the role responsibilities themselves emphasize data modelling strategy, metrics quality, and mentoring rather than speed, giving roughly balanced signals.
evidence.domain_risk: Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is a consumer delivery marketplace where analytics informs operational and business decisions at scale, but there is no regulatory or financial-reporting framing, keeping it moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Analytics at Wolt is a business-critical area that covers three different teams: data science, regional business operations, and analytics engineering
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Multiple named data sub-teams with distinct charters and a 'centrally maintained' data platform indicate an established, mature analytics function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Working on our centrally maintained data integrations and data pipelines powering our Data Warehouse, our data models, and dashboards. You'll get to utilize our modern tech stack as part of your work (Snowflake, SQL, Looker, Wolt Inhouse ETL, Airflow, Dagster, Github)
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name the exact tech stack and specific technical work (dependency control, orchestration, auto-materialisation), giving a precise picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: interpreting the needs and requests of our internal stakeholders from business and product, and transforming them into actionable data
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's closest partners are Data Scientists and its focus is the internal analytics/data function itself, even though it serves broader business and product needs.
evidence.autonomy_level: Develop a self-service data modelling strategy and partner with Analytics and other stakeholders for implementation
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role both develops strategy and leads/mentors juniors (strategic) while also executing scoped pipeline and dashboard work in service of business needs (execution), giving a mixed signal.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool usage or AI-enabling infrastructure work is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: There is no mention of testing frameworks, data contracts, or quality tooling in the responsibilities or requirements.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely around delivery, capability, and growth with no risk register or compliance language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Working on our centrally maintained data integrations and data pipelines powering our Data Warehouse
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role maintains and extends an already-established, centrally maintained data platform rather than building from scratch.
evidence.urgency: The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
